question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is __**by**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **By **is used as a **preposition **in above sentence.
 
• Here **by **is used to signify the Captain George Powell sight elephant seal.
 
• By is a **preposition **which indicates a method of accomplishing something.
